mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a sudden tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business confidence, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 95.0 for three consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity, signaling supply-side strength that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in supply-side strong periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 90.0 for three consecutive months indicates weak manufacturing activity, signaling supply-side weakness that compresses corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in supply-side weak periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over three consecutive months signals a cooling inflation environment, reducing policy rate uncertainty and supporting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflation-cooling periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 225.0 for three consecutive months signals accelerating price pressures, prompting aggressive policy tightening that compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in inflation-accelerating periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
